about: Added on 2026-10-05, after the run, so that the study can be run again. The steps are the study's own scripts in the order the run used them; get_data.py replaces the Yahoo Finance extracts, which the study does not ship.

notes: Yahoo's terms allow personal use only, so the study does not ship its extracts; get_data.py loads them again. Yahoo revises its history: prices adjusted for dividends change with every new dividend, and a delisted fund can disappear.
build_panel.py downloads the current Ken French daily factors. The run on 2026-09-11 read factors up to 2026-07-31; a later release adds months, which extends the panel, and revises past values.
With the study's own extracts (2026-09-11) and these packages, run_estimation.py reproduces results/estimation_results.json and results/robustness_results.json byte for byte.
